nodes.detail: Actual albedo evidence, palette hierarchy and distinct regional functions.

nodes.name: scene_layout

nodes.title: Player source

nodes.name: rig_player
nodes.title: Player rig + QA
nodes.detail: Source inspection, cleanup, semantic binding or preserved skin, five deformation poses.

nodes.name: mesh_boss
nodes.title: Boss source
nodes.detail: New source geometry with complete separated humanoid anatomy.

nodes.name: rig_boss
nodes.title: Boss rig + QA
nodes.detail: Independent anatomy, joints, weights, stretching and material checks.

nodes.name: scene
nodes.title: Detailed + structural scene
nodes.detail: Shared layout and transforms; detailed mesh, structural whitebox, routes and terrain reports.

nodes.name: ue_project
nodes.title: Isolated UE project
nodes.detail: Original runtime code and user-installed engine motion dependency; no inherited map.

nodes.name: animations
nodes.title: Motion retargeting
nodes.detail: 14 motion slots, semantic IK chains and measured locomotion stride.

nodes.name: ue_assemble
nodes.title: Rendering + gameplay
nodes.detail: PBR, Lumen, collision, combat, roaming and three switchable cameras.

nodes.name: scene_preflight
nodes.title: Current-view preflight
nodes.detail: Actual overview, full routes and centered destination views; inspect composition before full capture.

nodes.title: Early all-condition coverage
nodes.detail: All requested camera/activity jobs are captured at their full final settings and validated before long gameplay QA; exploration player occlusion is checked. Immutable verified exports may be reused later; calibration and final pair validation remain mandatory.
nodes.name: capture_probe
playtest
nodes.title: Gameplay regression
nodes.detail: Movement, actual hits, reset, visibility, frame timing, full routes and valid facing fault injection.

nodes.name: camera_validation
nodes.title: Camera switching
nodes.detail: Same-session first → third → isometric → third; input, owner visibility and default/switch policy.

nodes.name: capture_plan
nodes.title: Condition plan
nodes.detail: Three cameras × two activities; active start and five required channels. This adapter is deterministic.

nodes.name: calibration
nodes.title: Independent calibration
nodes.detail: Known geometry checks projection, RGB edges, depth, IDs and whitebox anchors.

nodes.name: dataset
nodes.title: Five-channel capture
nodes.detail: Post-animation synchronized native buffers plus PNG/NPY/JSON and viewing videos.

nodes.name: pair_validation
nodes.title: Native/export validation
nodes.detail: Frame-by-frame comparisons, integer label roundtrip, active contact and complete outputs.

nodes.name: review
nodes.title: Final visual review
nodes.detail: Current normal-run art, anatomy and all required test evidence; no stale screenshots.

nodes.name: delivery
nodes.title: Accepted release
nodes.detail: Exact project and launcher after hard gates. Executing agent then verifies replay and actual launch.
